steps.text: December 21st, 1097, 8:44 A.M.
Ancient Ruined Tower, Bleached Wasteland
Ruined buildings stand tall between the steep canyon walls, their purpose now unknown.
Those who live in the shadows of these ruins have brought life back to this barren land.

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: Here's your potato.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: How's production coming along?

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: Never thought you could grow so many of them in a car.

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: I've never seen farming like this before...

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: What's it called? Hy... hy something...

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Hydroponics. It's only become commonplace among nomadic cities in the last few decades or so. I'm not surprised that you didn't know about it.

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: You seem to know a lot about these things.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: A little bit. I've seen a lot of these farms on Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: But one car won't feed everyone.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: No worries. It's only a matter of time, now that we have the help of the Kazimierz scholars.

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: But all that knowhow is in the hands of that engineer and his team.

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: We're completely reliant on them.

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: And I still don't trust him.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Why not?

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: He's not even an Infected.

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: He says he's helping us because his wife and daughter died of Oripathy.

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: So it's because of his anger at the injustice of fate, and his sympathy for the Infected.

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: But what if he decides to start a new life, a new family?

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: Would it become inconvenient for him to keep supporting the Infected? Would he betray us for that new life?

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: He's not one of us, no matter what he says.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: You're making assumptions based on hypotheticals. Just because someone isn't Infected doesn't mean they're our enemy.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: We'll never make allies if we treat every act of kindness with suspicion.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Cooperation needs to start from trust. Even the word 'reunion' is all about coexistence, isn't it?

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: Did you already forget Talulah? That can't be allowed to happen again.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Then what we need is a contingency plan. Planning for a rainy day doesn't mean looking at everyone with suspicion though.

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: Fine, fine.

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: Has anyone ever told you that you're becoming more and more like Patriot?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Aw jeez, that's a little much, don't you think...?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Changing the topic—how are the clothes?

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: A little tight, but wearable.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: The material looks like it could stand up to some heavy use. Not bad.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: It's cheap and practical—ideal for combat attire.

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: Never thought I'd live to see the day.

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: How many years has it been since I last got something new to wear?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: You can thank the Infected workers in Caladon for that.

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: There's something that I don't quite understand, though.

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: Why are we taking down the Reunion symbol?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: We don't need it anymore.

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: We don't need Reunion?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: That's not what I meant.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: We just don't need a symbol anymore.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: We're linked by a common purpose, not by lines and shapes.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: We should be helping and supporting the other Infected, not differentiating ourselves from them.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: So why is Team 4 still wearing the symbol then?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: They have a special mission: running diversion.

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: I... I don't understand.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: They're operating in eastern Ursus, wearing the symbol in order to draw attention. That way, Ursus will think that there are only scattered remnants of Reunion roaming in the eastern wasteland.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Meanwhile, the rest of us can operate unnoticed by them, or any other country for that matter.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: They'll think that we're just rogues, operating independently. They won't connect us to Reunion, or give us a second thought.

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: Mr. Bean! You're here!

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Bean reporting back.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: How did it go?

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: No problem. Captain Red has delivered the equipment to the warehouse.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Good. I was getting worried when you reported a change in the situation.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: We encountered something unexpected in Caladon, but nothing we couldn't deal with.

steps.name: Elba
steps.text: Good morning, Mr. Guard.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Oh, hello, Miss Elba.

steps.name: Elba
steps.text: The rest of the Messengers are here.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: What's the situation in Columbia?

steps.name: Messenger Member
steps.text: It's a long story...

steps.name: Elba
steps.text: Life isn't easy for the Infected on the frontiers, and the help that we can provide is limited.

steps.name: Elba
steps.text: But the Columbians are giving land to homesteaders, even the Infected.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: I see...

steps.name: Messenger Member
steps.text: The Infected in Tkaronto are willing to provide supplies and housing. For a price, that is.

steps.name: Messenger Member
steps.text: There's a brewery owner who's offering to help for free though. He's a trustworthy guy, just a little... eccentric.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Sounds like a good start.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Good work, Miss Elba.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: What about the guerillas? Any response from Avrora?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Captain Avrora has travelled to the Northern Plains to find the troops who stayed behind. She probably won't make it here.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: However, Sarkaz warriors from the guerillas have already rendezvoused with Nine's team.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Reinforcements from Kazimierz arrived yesterday.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Then we're almost at full numbers.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: I'll check out the hangar. You guys go find Nine.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Got it.
A massive machine sits at the center of the abandoned warehouse, and industrial noises fill the air.
Reunion mechanics busy themselves around it, the sounds of metal cutting and welding following them wherever they go.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Lightly! Lightly! Don't break it!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: We've finally gotten the engine out of there.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Oh hey, Mr. Guard!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: How's the situation in Caladon? How are the Infected doing?

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Could be worse, all things considered.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Setting aside Councilor Angst for a moment, we have half the city council in favor of maintaining the Infected community. Things won't get any worse as long as the community continues to operate.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Two months ago, a nobleman bribed a security guard to sabotage their power generator. Things could've been really bad if we didn't happen to have an engineering Caster stationed there.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Still, the Infected face a lot of difficulties. They need help.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: I heard you encountered some trouble when transporting the engine?

steps.name: Red
steps.text: I would call it a little unpleasant surprise.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: As you predicted, there are a lot of people who don't look kindly upon the presence of the Infected community, but at least we took care of a bunch of problems.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Were our people at risk?

steps.name: Red
steps.text: No one got exposed, although there are a few guys who should probably lay low for a while.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: And we can't use the old supply tunnel anymore, after it got revealed by an explosion on the surface.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: We'll need to scale down activities in Caladon for a few months.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: It would seriously compromise the Infected community's day to day operations if anyone discovers our involvement.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Agreed.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: But the incident also allowed us to extract the engine without a hiccup, no traces.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: So... are you really sure this thing can fly?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: I've ridden on something like it before.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Over in Columbia, they use a smaller version in cities... what do they call them? Rotorcraft?

steps.name: Red
steps.text: I've seen recon rotorcrafts when I was in the Ursus army—about the size of a motorbike, maybe a little bigger.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: But I've never seen a flying machine this big before.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Where did you get this thing?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Would you believe me if I said I found it in a trash dump?

steps.name: Red
steps.text: I'm being serious.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Well, it's half-true.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: This is the only surviving prototype from a Columbian military project to develop a hovering vehicle. It was abandoned seven years ago due to lack of funding.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: After letting it rot in a warehouse for all those years, they finally decided to scrap it.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Now, the Columbians usually outsource the scrapping of military equipment to third-party contractors. There are just too many projects to handle themselves.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: But as you can imagine, the contractor didn't exactly follow military SOP. All they did was take it apart and sell the parts to a 'scrap recycler'.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: And this 'scrap recycler' sold the 'scrap' to us.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: How did you even hear about the prototype?

steps.name: Engineer Andrey
steps.text: That a-hole Dijkstra, of course.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Dijkstra? That weird Columbian Caster? The one who calls himself a 'Cracker'?

steps.name: Red
steps.text: That's pretty amazing.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: So, what do you think, Andrey? Is the engine good to go?

steps.name: Engineer Andrey
steps.text: It's got enough muscle, alright.

steps.name: Engineer Andrey
steps.text: But it's a little big... could throw off the machine's balance.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Are you really sure about putting a Victorian engine on a Columbian flyer?

steps.name: Engineer Andrey
steps.text: We'll find a way. Getting it in the air shouldn't be a problem, at least.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Looking forward to it.

steps.name: Engineer Andrey
steps.text: It's not like you could fly this with a standard driving license, though. What about pilots?

steps.name: Engineer Andrey
steps.text: It needs two of them, and not many have the required skills, even in Columbia.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Nine was concerned about that too, but Dijkstra said he had an idea.

steps.name: Engineer Andrey
steps.text: Either way, we've got more pressing issues right now.

steps.name: Engineer Andrey
steps.text: We need a whole new control system, and that's not something I can whip up for you. You'll have to find one.

steps.name: Engineer Andrey
steps.text: Not just any old thing will do, either. It needs to be something on the scale of a mining platform control system.

steps.name: Engineer Andrey
steps.text: We'll also need to replace the insulation plates for the Originium engine.

steps.name: Engineer Andrey
steps.text: I already told Nine about all this, but I don't know if there's been any progress on that front.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: No worries, a trader will be bringing them over in a few days.

steps.name: Engineer Andrey
steps.text: Are you talking about that bucket-head? He's got nerve, selling this stuff... How did he even get his hands on classified technology anyway?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: He's got his methods. Best not to ask too many questions.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Oh, Nine! Hey there.

steps.name: Engineer Andrey
steps.text: Well, you're the boss.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Speaking of which, Guard, you may need to bring Captain Red over to meet with the trader.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: He wants someone from our side to be on site and 'have an understanding of the sourcing', in his own words.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: What a weirdo...

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: But alright.
December 24th, 1097, 6:44 P.M.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: So this is the rendezvous point.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Are you sure we can trust this guy?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Hard to say... but Nine trusts him, at least.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: We've bought a lot of stuff from him, and in return he's asked us to do him a number of favors.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: He's eccentric, to say the least... you'll understand when you see him.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: I have a hard time trusting shady merchants like this...
A man wearing a strange helmet approaches from afar.
He is accompanied by several large men wearing shabby armor.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Yup... He might as well be carrying a sign that says 'Shady' in big red letters.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Good morning, good afternoon, and good evening, my friends.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Mr. Guard! How good to see you again, and looking so well too.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: I wasn't expecting you to bring company. But I'm not seeing any trucks or vehicles?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Where are the goods, Mr. Cannot?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: No rush, my friend, no rush!

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: They're not in my hands right now, but they'll show themselves soon enough.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: I don't understand.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Have patience, friend, patience. They'll be here.
A few minutes later, a convoy of armed vehicles appears on the horizon, kicking up a cloud of dust over the barren ground.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Here they come.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Give me the binoculars.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Take cover! Take cover! They're armed with Originium cannons!

steps.name: Elba
steps.text: That's... Volvort Kochinski's mark!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: I want an explanation, Mr. Cannot!

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: What you seek is right in front of you, my friend. You see that big one in the middle?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: It's delivering a whole set of industrial-grade Originium engines and control systems from Columbia to Rim Billiton.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: You want us to raid an armed Columbian convoy?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: That's your plan? You'd need heavy artillery to even put a dent in that armor!

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: No need to get excited, my friend. Did you think I was going to make a customer do it themselves?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Just sit back, and watch.
About fifteen minutes later, the convoy passes through a canyon.
Ballista turrets and Originium cannons are on full alert, sweeping the surroundings for potential threats.
Driven by powerful engines, the heavily armored vehicles dash across the rugged landscape.
It is a loadout intended to take them safely across the Terran wasteland to their destination.
But there are very few guarantees in the wastes.
A boulder suddenly stands up from the ground, reaching eight meters in height, dirt falling off it like a waterfall.
It is a Metal Crab, camouflaged as a rock.
The creature charges at the convoy.
The cannons unload onto the beast, while the ballistae aim for its joints.
However, their efforts prove futile at slowing it down.
The Metal Crab smashes into the side of the large truck at full speed.
The armored vehicle topples over violently, crushing one of its escorts.
War cries and the sounds of clanging metal echo through the canyon.
Hundreds of strangely dressed warriors charge out from the shadows, from behind rocks or cracks in the canyon walls.
They throw explosives made from Originium crystals at the convoy, and fire at stragglers using improvised ballistae.
It is a scene of chaos, as the convoy's guards try to flee for their lives.
The outcome of the battle is never once in doubt.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: It would be nice if our friends over there could be a little more careful... I'll need to check up on the equipment later, make sure there's no damage.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: See, I would have liked to deliver the goods earlier, but things didn't go quite as planned...

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: The convoy took a detour to avoid a Catastrophe, delaying their arrival.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: (Draws weapon)

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: (Draws weapon)

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Dear me. It seems we have a misunderstanding here.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Mr. Cannot... you never told us you were a member of Rusthammer.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Reunion hasn't fallen so far that we need to traffic with bandits.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: My, my! What a hurtful accusation.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: And an untimely one, I should add.
The Rusthammer warriors behind Cannot draw their weapons.

steps.name: Rusthammer Warrior
steps.text: Watch your mouth, or I'll smash it in for you.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: I'd like to see you try.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Hold on, my friends! Calm down!

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: We're not here to fight today, are we?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: We're here for a reason. There's no need for us to go at each others' throats like wild animals.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Come now, Mr. Gareth, put away that weapon, will you? Didn't we agree that I would handle the negotiations?

steps.name: Elba
steps.text: Gareth...?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: That voice... Elba!?

steps.name: Elba
steps.text: It's you! You're alive!

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: I never thought I'd see you here!

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: I didn't recognize you in that outfit.

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: Gareth? Gareth 'Swiftblade'? You're alive?!

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: W-Why are you with Rusthammer?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Oh, it's you guys!
The warriors look at each other in bewilderment, still gripping their weapons, but seemingly unsure what to do with them.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Brothers, it's fine, I know them!

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Put down your weapons! They're okay!

steps.name: Elba
steps.text: It's really you...

steps.name: Elba
steps.text: I thought you had...

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: It's a long story.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: See, we're all friends here, aren't we? Maybe even relatives, if we go back a few thousand years. How about we find somewhere else to chat?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Per my agreement with your other leader, I'll deliver this equipment to your... base?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Mr. Gareth, would you kindly bring a few other men with us to deliver the goods?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Will do.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Are we seriously considering letting this guy into our base?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: It wouldn't be his first time. We just have to trust Nine's judgment...

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Beautiful! Simply beautiful!

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: You really fixed the thing!

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: I told you we could do it.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Reunion has surpassed the expectations of more than a few people. You certainly get things done.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: So, forty Originium Ingots, as agreed? My humble commission is included in the price, of course.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Thank you for your generosity, Mr. Cannot.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: What exactly are you planning, can-head? Just forty ingots for all this?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Why the mistrust, my friend?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Cooperation needs to start from trust. Conversely, considering our long history, it would do well for you to trust me a little more.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Think of it as an investment. I see bigger and better things in your future, and even more opportunities for us to work together.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Look at that hovercraft and tell me what you see.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: A hovercraft.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: I see OPPORTUNITY!

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: With that, you will be able to traverse the wastes at no less than two hundred kilometers an hour, zooming from nomadic city to nomadic city. How many organizations on Terra can claim that kind of capability?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Now, what you do with it is none of my concern, but I would suggest treating it with care... It's not exactly an easy thing to repair.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Thank you for your assistance, Mr. Cannot.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Of course, my friend. Best of luck in your future endeavors.

steps.name: Elba
steps.text: Rusthammer is... different from how I imagined.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: A lot of people misunderstand them, but they're not concerned with what outsiders... with what 'civilized' people think of them.

steps.name: Elba
steps.text: ...Can I ask you a question?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Elba
steps.text: Is Illa with you? What...

steps.name: Elba
steps.text: What happened to her?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Illa?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Don't worry, she's fine.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: She's just... not feeling too well.

steps.name: Elba
steps.text: Are her Oripathy symptoms worsening?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: No, no, it's not Oripathy, don't worry.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: She... well, she's pregnant.

steps.name: Elba
steps.text: P-Pregnant?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Can you imagine it? I'm going to be a dad!

steps.name: Elba
steps.text: Oh... wow, so you guys have...

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Don't worry, our Rusthammer brothers and sisters are taking good care of her. Those who are born onto the wasteland are blessed by the storms and the great earth.

steps.name: Elba
steps.text: That's not what I was worried about.

steps.name: Elba
steps.text: I just didn't think that you would... hehe.

steps.name: Elba
steps.text: Anyway, congratulations.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: I spent a lot of time thinking it over...

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Whether it would be irresponsible to bring a new life into this world, only for them to grow up in pain and suffering.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: But at last, Illa told me that she wanted to be a mother.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: And so I decided that I would do everything I could to protect and educate my child, whatever awaits them in the future.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: They will grow up to be a better person than I am.

steps.name: Elba
steps.text: I... I really admire you.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Time to go, Mr. Gareth. Our work here is done.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Got it.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Goodbye, Elba. I thought I'd never see you again. It's been a blessed day.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Live long, Elba!

steps.name: Elba
steps.text: You too.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Did you want to spend more time with your old friend? You can have it, you know.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: It's fine. We've said what we needed to.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Very well then, let's go.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Well, look who's waiting for us. Did you have any unfinished business?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Impressive, by the way, to completely elude my notice.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Do not underestimate Catastrophe Messengers.

steps.name: Elba
steps.text: Do you remember me, Mr. Cannot?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Of course, Miss Elba.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: I remember everyone I've ever met. That said, you've changed so much over the past year that I could barely recognize you.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: It is always good to see old friends doing so well.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: You call everybody a 'friend'.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Do you really understand how much weight that word carries?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: If we're truly 'friends'...

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Then I must ask you to answer a question before you leave. And answer truthfully.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: As you said yourself, cooperation needs to start from trust.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: So I need an answer that will develop that trust.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Certainly. Go ahead.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Why are you helping us?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Don't try to dodge the question, or get around it with sophistry.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: I want to hear the truth.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Hahaha...
The man wearing a bucket on his head laughs wryly.
For a moment, he gazes quietly at the Reunion member before him, his eyes cloudy under the heavy helmet.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: It was never my intention to play with words.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: But not everyone is able to accept the stark, unvarnished truth.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Some truths are better left unspoken, my dear Miss Nine.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Reunion does not need lies and deception.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: You have roamed the wastelands, the myriad realms of Terra. What have you seen?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Let me tell you what I've seen.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: On the frontiers of Columbia, I saw the both Infected and the poor caught between barren soil and dangerous beasts.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Their human dignity is built upon flesh and blood, but beneath the bodies lies the gold that made the monster that is Columbia.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: The people of Victoria cling to history and tradition like their lives depend on it. Their wealth and power serve only those who already have them—the greedy and self-serving noble class.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: To them, the Infected might be tools in their political plots, or weapons against their enemies, but never human beings.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: The 'most powerful country in Terra', and you could barely call it a civilization.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Two years ago, the Columbians turned a deaf ear to a Sami Snowpriest who prophesied that the End of Days is near.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: The Columbians said the Snowpriest was mad, but what do they know?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: They know nothing of Sami's long struggle against the frenzied darkness.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Sooner or later, this land... nay, the entire world must face the truth of that madness.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: The dark shadow beneath the northern tundra, the great gloom deep in the ocean, not to mention ancient calamity buried under the earth.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Despite all this, the people of the land live on secluded islands, waging wars against each other with sticks and stones.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Time is running out. The world is falling apart, and change must come sooner rather than later!

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Is that why you're helping us?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: One of the reasons.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: I support any group that is trying to change things, be it Rusthammer or Reunion, or even those who merely sense the ship beginning to sink and are trying to save themselves.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Someone needs to do something.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: I've provided assistance to many individuals and organizations, from Rusthammer to Reunion, to the Cyclopes of Sami, to the mystics of Sargon...

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Unfortunately, no one has been able to come up with a solution.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: But at the very least, I can point the way.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: For better or for worse, we have to try.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Even if all you say is true, Mr. Cannot, I'm still not convinced.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Saving the world from danger is beyond Reunion's ability. It's not our job.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: I understand. But it can be a catalyst. We must start the engine before we discuss which way to go.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: You're better off looking to the idealists of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Rhodes Island alone is not enough, despite the talent they've gathered.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Have you heard of what they did in Kazimierz?

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Of course. I was there.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: They made a fine move, but one move will not be enough to bring victory in this great game. No one is more aware of that than themselves.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Even the resplendent fire burning in the Radiant Knight's heart is not enough to drive the dark clouds from the land.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: Of course, it is still gratifying to see people like them, in this world of pain and hatred.

steps.name: Cannot
steps.text: 'Even as dark clouds gather, the spark of hope glows bright.'
